summary: The StudentAssessments user control allows students and staff to view, filter, interact with, and generate reports for student assessments. It is part of an ASP.NET WebForms application, integrating business logic, data access, and user interface controls. It manages workflows for assessment viewing, status tracking, downloading CSV reports, and supports interactive filtering by course and assessment template.
purpose: Enable students (or staff agents) to interact with their placement-related assessments: filtering, viewing status and details, generating downloadable CSV reports, and accessing combined views when conditions are met.
actors: System (for report generation, file download, data binding)

workflows.name: Assessment Listing and Filtering
steps: Load StudentAssessments control.
On first load, set FirstDataLoad ViewState.
Call Refresh(true) to bind data if user session is valid.
FillCourseDropdown() with available assessments, select course.
FillAssessmentTemplateDropdown() with templates.
Bind gridData to filtered PlacementRequestAssessments.
Allow sorting by Course, Date, Assessment, Type.
Enable filtering via course and assessment template drop-downs.
Support combined view hyperlink if final/interim assessment submitted.

workflows.name: Assessment Row Interaction
steps: Bind row data in gridData_RowDataBound.
Setup progress icons and hyperlinks for each assessment row.
Show Open/View/Closed status depending on Assessment state, user role, time, and status.
Joint assessment indicator shown for submitted assessments with a joint ID.
Apply warningCaption style to rows when assessment window is active.

workflows.name: CSV Report Generation and Download
steps: Button btnGenerateReport triggers cohort assessment CSV generation.
Context information and metadata assembled (summary, author, agency).
Call ReportMain.OutputCSV to generate HTML and physical file.
Display report HTML, file link, and download button if .csv file produced.
lnkDownloadFile_Click triggers download logic, generates valid filename, and serves file.
Error messages displayed in lblReportHTML.

business_rules: Student can only view/edit their own assessments (UserSession.StudentUser && UserSession.StaffID == StudentID).
Course and assessment template dropdowns must be populated based on available data.
Combined view is only shown if interim or final student assessment is submitted.
Grid rows styled with warningCaption when assessment window active.
Report generation only allowed if ScreenIsEditable is true.
Download link and report HTML only shown if CSV file generated.
validations: Validate UUID format before matching keys.
UserSession must be valid before data selection.
Dropdown selection must reflect current ID and value.
Only valid assessments/templates shown based on user context.
calculations: Assessment window calculation: DistributionOpenDate <= LocalDateTime < DistributionCloseDate.AddDays(1)
CSV filename generated dynamically from student/course/template data
Combined view decision based on CombinedTypeEarliestStatusCode for interim/final assessment
conditions: First data load triggers refresh and initial setup.
Grid sorted by default on Course unless user sorts by other columns.
Show/hide download/report panel based on report generation result.
Show/hide combined view link based on assessment status.
system_behavior: Auto-refreshes and binds data for the logged-in user.
Supports sorting and filtering of assessments in grid.
Combines data from multiple assessments, templates, and courses.
Generates downloadable CSV and displays HTML preview.
Handles row data-bound events for status and progress.
Handles file download and error reporting.
exceptions: Invalid user session cancels data source selection.
Failed report generation hides download link, shows error.
UUID casting errors handled by safe SQL.
